headline: Iran says it will use all means to confront US naval blockade
summary: Iran will use all available means to respond to the US naval blockade, Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei said at a weekly press conference on Monday.
why: Naval blockades affect shipping routes and energy flows through key sea lanes, which can influence oil and freight markets.
original_headline: Irán asegura que utilizará todos los medios para hacer frente al bloqueo naval de EU
